plugins.name: RomuLation
plugins.author: MoveWeight
plugins.description: Searches RomuLation with region and real file size per hit; ROMarr Capture mirrors rendered search rows and identifies the paid browser session needed for downloads.
plugins.terms: RomuLation hosts mixed game content. This provider indexes metadata the site publishes on its own search page, downloads nothing, and does not touch the paths its robots.txt disallows. It grants no redistribution rights; operators are responsible for using it in accordance with applicable law and the source's terms.
plugins.comments: The standalone plugin is search-only: RomuLation's download is behind a paid account and an encrypted per-render token. ROMarr Capture now reads the rendered search rows and search metadata marks download_requires_browser/account_required, allowing clients to present the operator's authenticated browser as the next step without claiming its session. No stream: the site hosts no player. All 17 platforms map to a ROMarr slug.
